description:
## What changed

Every control Hushfeed draws over the video now answers a press and shows where the focus is: the four feed controls, the two actions on the daily hold, Undo, Clear all in the inbox and the sticker Save button. The settings screen's hand-built actions do the same, so tabbing through the Feature Gate Lab with a keyboard, a d-pad or switch access shows the focus moving, and a gate you have chosen there looks chosen. On host surfaces that follow TikTok's theme the ring and ripple take the host's own colour, so they show in the light theme too.

The daily hold no longer reads itself out once a second to TalkBack. It is announced once when it goes up, only the time remaining is live, and nothing is rewritten unless it changed. The daily budget label stays on the feed and off the comment sheet, profile pages and search results.

Wording and translation. One sentence asks you to restart TikTok, not nine, and the Region rows no longer ask twice. The Region summaries name the switches they depend on by the titles those switches carry in German, Spanish, Indonesian and Brazilian Portuguese. The daily budget rows, the feed tab picker and the unit words beside numbers are translated. The section rows say how many settings you have changed rather than how many are on. Four patch descriptions in Morphe Manager lost a stray space and a credit line, and Diagnostic tools now says Hushfeed and where its switches live.

Fixes people will meet. The hidden creators editor keeps what you typed and says what is wrong under the box instead of closing. The two country lists in the feed filter check what you type, and "UK" works. Copying a sound link cleans it the way a video link already was, and both copied links are marked sensitive. The Not interested button no longer goes dead for the rest of the session when the worker pool is full. The App behavior page opens again on a bundle carrying only the launcher shortcuts patch. Double tap set to open comments now opens them, confirmed on the S22. The exported diagnostic report no longer names the creators you block, hide or follow, and Diagnostics has a row for the on-screen failure messages.

The text, range and tab rows say when they need a restart, the About row names the TikTok build and the settings search finds it, Hook status speaks for the sensitive-warning switch, and the README and the Region page say what Downloads does with restricted videos and what spoofing cannot change. The release gate that holds the README and the index to the generated catalog is now itself tested.

## Validation

The release passed 1,267 runtime tests and 178 patch tests with no failures or skips. Both Android API checks passed. The bundle carries 79 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty.

All 79 patches applied with zero failures to the TikTok 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures. The provenance receipt attached to this release records every verdict, the source commit and the bundle hash. Hushfeed targets the global TikTok 46.2.3 package. Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer is required.

On a Galaxy S22 running this build: the block button blocked the creator whose video was on screen after normal scrolling, after fast flinging, on a text post and on a five-image photo carousel, and Undo put each one back. Follows landed with Hide CAPTCHA popups on, including after opening Hushfeed settings, after changing a setting, and after a restart.
